# TRAVNY full guide

Source: https://trfny.com/

> Complete machine-readable map of the public TRAVNY hub, related services, stable endpoints and published texts.

## Identity and hosts

- Canonical hub: https://trfny.com/
- Emergency fallback: https://travny.pages.dev/ — serves the same Pages output with `noindex, follow`.
- Legacy Pages host: https://tvpi.pages.dev/ — permanently redirects to the canonical host while preserving path and query.
- Repository: https://github.com/trvny/tvpi

The hub is a lightweight static/edge site. It links independent services rather than hiding them behind one application runtime.

## Hub routes

### Home

- Human page: https://trfny.com/
- Markdown representation: https://trfny.com/index.md
- Concise LLM guide: https://trfny.com/llms.txt
- This full guide: https://trfny.com/llms-full.txt

### TVPI

- Human TV page: https://trfny.com/tv/
- Markdown page: https://trfny.com/tv/index.md
- Streaming Worker: https://tvpi.trfny.com/
- Worker overview: https://tvpi.trfny.com/index.md
- Worker LLM guide: https://tvpi.trfny.com/llms.txt
- Worker full guide: https://tvpi.trfny.com/llms-full.txt
- Stable combined playlist: https://tvpi.trfny.com/playlist.m3u
- Raw GitHub playlist fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trvny/tvpi/main/streams/playlist.m3u

TVP upstream stream signatures are short-lived. Consumers should save the stable Worker URLs. Per-channel `.m3u8` endpoints resolve or serve fresh HLS data behind a durable URL.

### Teksty

- Human index: https://trfny.com/teksty/
- Markdown index: https://trfny.com/teksty/index.md
- Tokenowy Mundial AI: https://trfny.com/teksty/token-worldcup/
- Maintained Quarto source: https://github.com/trvny/trvny/blob/main/stuff/other/token-worldcup/token-worldcup.qmd
- Verified generated HTML source: https://github.com/trvny/trvny/blob/main/stuff/other/token-worldcup/token-worldcup.html

TRAVNY proxies the generated Token Cup artifact rather than maintaining a second copy. The article compares token counts for equivalent natural text in 27 languages using `o200k_base`; English is the normalized index baseline (`EN = 100`) while the measured English sample is 95 tokens.

## Related services

### Weather

- Dashboard: https://weather.trfny.com/
- LLM guide: https://weather.trfny.com/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://weather.trfny.com/llms-full.txt
- Current ensemble JSON: https://weather.trfny.com/state.json
- Weather changes Atom feed: https://weather.trfny.com/feed.atom
- IMGW warnings Atom feed: https://weather.trfny.com/warnings.atom

The service combines multiple sources for Kościelec in Chrzanów and includes temperature, wind, humidity, air quality, pollen and IMGW warnings.

### Feedseek

- Directory: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/
- LLM guide: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/llms-full.txt
- Markdown directory: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/index.md
- OPML bundle: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/subscriptions.opml
- Sitemap: https://trvny.github.io/feedseek/sitemap.xml
- Source: https://github.com/trvny/feedseek

Feedseek publishes self-updating Atom/RSS feeds, JSON Feed sidecars, OPML and a browser Reader. Its own guides are the source of truth for the current feed inventory and supported WebMCP tools.

### Streambench

- Application: https://streambench.trfny.com/
- Markdown page: https://streambench.trfny.com/index.md
- LLM guide: https://streambench.trfny.com/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://streambench.trfny.com/llms-full.txt
- Health JSON: https://streambench.trfny.com/health
- Provider manifest: https://streambench.trfny.com/api/providers

Streambench is a local-first IPTV, internet-radio, HLS, M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV workshop. Local files, edits, favorites and history remain in the browser.

### Code Bench

- Application: https://codebench.trfny.com/
- Markdown page: https://codebench.trfny.com/index.md
- LLM guide: https://codebench.trfny.com/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://codebench.trfny.com/llms-full.txt

Code Bench creates, styles, scans and exports QR codes and barcodes. User payloads are processed in browser state.

### Doc Bench

- Application: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/
- Markdown page: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/index.md
- LLM guide: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt
- Full guide: https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt

Doc Bench edits text and structured documents and performs PDF maintenance locally in the browser. Its own guide documents which WebMCP tools can expose current editor state to an agent.

## Discovery files

- Sitemap: https://trfny.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://trfny.com/robots.txt
- Web manifest: https://trfny.com/site.webmanifest
- Hub Markdown: https://trfny.com/index.md
- TVPI Markdown: https://trfny.com/tv/index.md
- Teksty Markdown: https://trfny.com/teksty/index.md

The sitemap contains public human-facing hub routes. Service-specific machine-readable resources live on their owning service and are linked here rather than duplicated.

## Source-of-truth rules

- `trvny/tvpi` owns the TRAVNY hub and TVPI streaming Worker.
- Each linked service owns its detailed capability and agent-access documentation in its own `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt`.
- Tokenowy Mundial AI is maintained in `trvny/trvny/stuff/other/token-worldcup/`; TRAVNY only publishes it through the article route.
- Generated or proxied artifacts are not separate maintained sources.
